title: Happy Bolton, Zutty Singleton and Joe Lindsey
summary: He recalls Red Happy at the Lyric Theater with Robichaux, Zutty Singleton, whom he knew in New York, and Joe Lindsey.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
